invoice_findings.description: volume discount not applied in full: 40 consignments tendered in 2026-07; 5% of the expected subtotal ₹20,149.26 is ₹1,007.46, billed discount ₹0.00. A further ₹20.63 to ₹23.75 depends on ALPINE-0726#5, which is escalated separately.
invoice_findings.justification: Alpine tendered 40 consignments in 2026-07, exceeding the 12-consignment threshold in §5, which entitles BlueFin to a 5% discount on the invoice total for that month. The invoice was billed with no discount applied, so the carrier owes the shortfall on the determinable lines.
